audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[0..5] read Zed and win[6] reads Ekko, matching the packet chart.
audit.why: Ekko's early kit is a 9s Phase Dive at 325 range and a passive that needs three hits on the same target; Zed's 900-range Q on a flat 6s wins that. Two items in, Chronobreak falls to 50s and simply undoes the mark.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Zed on rows 0-5 and Ekko on row 6, ratings adjusted, all seven whys rewritten to match. win[N] already agrees, so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Chronobreak as one fixed threat and never notes that its cooldown collapses from 110s at rank 1 to 50s at rank 3 — which is the actual reason the matchup inverts late.
audit.why: Kit: Chronobreak 110/80/50. At rank 1 you can play around a two-minute window; at rank 3 it is up for nearly every skirmish.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and phases[6].why now state the 110s-to-50s drop.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions the missing-interactions file flags are absent: Chronobreak heals Ekko for a share of the damage he took, so Grievous Wounds timing decides the fight; and Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up rather than the cast is the tell. The page also never mentions Parallel Convergence's delayed anomaly, which stuns when Ekko enters it.
audit.why: Riot's text on Chronobreak: untargetable, rewinds, heals for a percentage of damage received. Phase Dive carries the autoReset flag and a 325 range. Parallel Convergence carries hardCC and shield flags at 1600 range on a 22/20/18/16/14 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the itemization entry; the reset tell written into the Don'ts bullet; the anomaly into the Do's bullet.

audit.why: Chronobreak 110/80/50, Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14, Phase Dive 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16.
